properties.note:
The asymmetry this recorded is closed on the WRITE path: a property declared `node_ref` is now refused when it names a node that does not exist, the same refusal an edge endpoint has had since 2026-07-28, pinned by `crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_property_that_names_a_node_is_guarded.rs` (8 tests, observed failing before the guard existed).

🛑 BOUNDED, because the fact's own scope note is still true and must not be read as closed with it: a write-time guard reaches only the values that were WRONG WHEN WRITTEN. Measured 2026-08-29 on this graph's nine dangling references, five are the `prj:`/`proj:` typo this refuses and four were VALID WHEN WRITTEN and broke later when the target was renamed. Those need detection over the graph as it stands, which is a separate cause with a separate fix and is not claimed here.
